diagnosis: WorkspaceBoardDiscoveryView returns workspace boards accessible to a team by querying the ArrayField authorized_team_ids__overlap. The view trusts the client-provided team_id from query parameters without verifying that request.user is a valid member of that team. An attacker can supply arbitrary team IDs to access task boards, roadmap milestones, and project data of other teams.

GET /api/workspaces/boards/?team_id=88 HTTP/1.1
